metadata.title: Contact
metadata.description: Questions, bug reports, feature ideas, or partnerships — send the BIShare team a message and we'll reply within 24–48 hours.

hero.title: Get in touch
hero.subtitle: A question, a bug, an idea, or a partnership — we read every message.

aside.emailBody: Write to us directly at <link>{email}</link>. It reaches the same team.
aside.privacyBody: Your name and email are used only to reply to your message. See our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

bugReport.label: Bug Report
bugReport.placeholder: Describe the issue and the steps to reproduce it…

featureRequest.label: Feature Request
featureRequest.placeholder: Describe the feature you'd like to see…

partnership.label: Partnership
partnership.placeholder: Tell us about your company and how we could work together…

form.footerNote: We typically reply within 24–48 hours. Prefer email? Write to <link>{email}</link>.
form.errorInvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
form.errorTooLong: Your message is too long — please keep it under {max} characters.
form.errorGeneric: Something went wrong while sending your message. Please try again.
form.errorNetwork: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
form.errorEmailFallback: You can also email us at <link>{email}</link>.
form.successBody: Thanks for reaching out. We typically reply within 24–48 hours.
